newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Lombard rate leaps to 362.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania Lombard rate leaps to 362.16 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the Lombard rate had soared to 362.16 percent from a previous 200.72 percent following an increase in the average rate on one-week refinancing funds.
The Lombard rate, set weekly by multiplying the average auctioned rate by 1.6, is charged on overdraft credits.
The one-week rate surged to 226.35 percent on Thursday from 125.45 percent last week after the BNR refinancing auction was heavily oversubscrobed on a cash-starved money market.
Interbank money market traders said short-term prices were expected to climb towards 250 percent on Friday against some 160 percent on Thursday.

Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu said the BNR would forge ahead with plans to use monetary levers to fight rising inflation, restore confidence in the leu, which has sunk by some 120 percent to about 9,000 to the dollar since January 1.
